## 🛠️ Every tool, more reliable

A full pass over the app's tools, fixing about 30 bugs.

### 📝 Documents

- Layout indent/spacing fields no longer send digits into the document; Enter returns to the text exactly where you were
- Format painter and Clear formatting keep comments, tracked changes, links and bookmarks
- Paste from the menu and the Home tab works like ⌘V; links can be inserted without a selection
- Replace no longer loops when the replacement contains the search term
- Sort understands decimals, ISO dates and month names; invalid values go last
- Comments and bookmarks are placed correctly after fields and images
- Cross-references work in every language; the thesaurus keeps bold/italic
- One eraser pass is a single undo step; dictation inserts plain text
- Citations use "pp." for page ranges; date fields no longer show yesterday after midnight
- YouTube start times like "1m30s" are respected; invalid image URLs are reported

### ✉️ Mail merge

- Greeting line without a name no longer prints "Dear customer, ,"
- A quote inside a CSV cell no longer swallows the rest of the file

### 🧠 Boards

- Connectors inside sections and frames can be clicked, selected and labelled
- Style panel changes can be undone; "Zoom to 100%" keeps the center
- Pasting text from another app no longer re-pastes old elements

### 🧩 Add-ins, import & export

- Readability, Signature, QR, Wikipedia and Openverse fixes
- Markdown round-trips cleanly; charts read pasted numbers in your language

## 🔄 Upgrading

Nothing to do: your files stay in your browser.
